interpretation.relevance_labels: Weak supervision from real repository topics and descriptions with hard same-language negatives.
interpretation.adoption_labels: Real PyPI recent-week versus preceding-month acceleration; future snapshot deltas take precedence when available.
limitations: The relevance benchmark is automatically constructed and easier than a blinded human gold set.
Twelve adoption labels prove the multi-task path but are insufficient for a robust adoption forecast.
A single capture cannot yet validate 30-day or 90-day future growth.
